name: logging-tracing-design
description: Design logging + distributed tracing for a service or system. Structured logging (JSON schema, log levels, correlation ids), OpenTelemetry tracing (W3C Trace Context propagation, span attributes + events + links, sampling strategy — head vs tail, rate-based vs probabilistic), log-to-trace linking via trace_id, PII redaction, retention + cost control, log ingestion targets. Component-level responsibility distinct from observability-strategy (system-wide). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
